Select distinct ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the neuropeptide S receptor (CHEMBL5162) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5162 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return the columns as molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
